text.tspan: Two ways config reaches a container
Change → seen only after a pod restart
Change → file updates after a short delay
app must re-read it · never with subPath
Roll pods on a config change: kubectl rollout restart · Helm checksum/config annotation · Kustomize configMapGenerator.
Protect Secrets: KMS encryption at rest · RBAC (list = read the values) · External Secrets from Secrets Manager.
